summary.text: Son of Priam and Hecuba whom Apollodorus counts among the king's children by the queen — Homer names only the Danaan leader Hipponous whom Hector slew (`hipponous-achaean`), not this Trojan prince.

story.text: Apollodorus names Hipponous among the sons whom Hecuba bore to Priam, in the roll that runs Deiphobus, Helenus, Pammon, Polites, Antiphus, Hipponous, Polydorus, and Troilus.

Apollodorus counts him in Priam's stemma by Hecuba, but Homer never names this Trojan prince — only the Danaan leader Hipponous whom Hector slew. Troy sky membership follows the priamid roll; the summary-only residence-citation rule finds no isolated Ilion sentence, so `residences` citation stays intentionally unset.
